bundle.shortDescription: Plants of the Western Ghats: names, synonyms, distribution maps and pictures
bundle.longDescription: Version 1 (original): the 2015 Western Ghats Mapping program rebuilt. Search the plants of the Western Ghats by genus, species, habit, common name or map grid; see taxonomy, distribution maps, pictures, distribution data, synonyms and common names. Works offline.
